_comment: ТЗ v1.2 §13 / v1.3 §12.8 — the acceptance set, in ONE file. It is used twice: as a test of the AUDITOR (the rule must find the known problem) and as a test of the CALCULATION LAYER (after the fix the number must be right). Keeping it here rather than inline in two test files is the point: a case fixed in one place and forgotten in the other is exactly how a defect returns two months later. Every row was verified by hand against the live API on 31.07.2026. `was` is what the system showed then; `should_be` is what it must show now.

absolute_metrics.why: the 21 points spanned 293 days; a 30-day window has too few
computed on full history; identical at 1M/3M/6M/1Y/3Y/5Y
one security cannot have six different year-to-date returns
a null must carry its reason

moving_average.why: averaging 20 weekly candles is not a 20-day average
line and candle mode must draw one line

quality.why: a page without history is a state, not an error
245 points — a liquid security keeps its candles

multiples.why: the denominator is the issuer's profit, not the class's
one issuer, one profit, one P/E
a thousandfold gap is a units error in the share count

financials.why: a half-year revenue 131 times the annual is a parse error
shown as «данные проверяются», never as a figure

financials.should_be: one period per column, sort normalised to 12 months

financials.why: outliers may not rank beside real values

market_map.should_be: marked: 1 trade, 1 security, 30 720 sums; excluded from the top without a mark

market_map.why: no data is not zero, and must not vote in a sector average
8 trades on 34 050 000 sums — a join gap, not an absent price
price 0.01 sum: rounding before the division erases every move
a simple mean with zeros in it

bonds.why: a traded contour that exists in the data and not in the interface
these are real sessions, not a rounding of zero
the wrong class is how a bond reaches the equity branches at all
no nominal, coupon or maturity is published anywhere; an invented par is not a fallback

source_catalog.why: 73 rows are 66 organisations; five bond series showed 0 reports
«where did this revenue come from» must be answerable

source_catalog.was: 10 days, shown as a bare date
source_catalog.should_be: stated in words when older than the threshold
